items.title_cn: 急性胰腺炎：临床病程、现代诊断与治疗原则
items.title_en: ACUTE PANCREATITIS: CLINICAL COURSE, MODERN DIAGNOSTICS, AND TREATMENT PRINCIPLES
items.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了急性胰腺炎的临床病程、现代诊断方法及治疗原则。分析了其主要临床表现、病因因素、实验室指标、影像学表现、疾病严重程度、并发症及治疗结局。结果表明，胆道疾病是最常见的病因，而严重的上腹痛、恶心、呕吐及腹部压痛是主要的临床表现。血清脂肪酶及影像学方法在诊断和评估疾病严重程度方面发挥了重要作用。大多数患者为轻型急性胰腺炎，经保守治疗后预后良好。该研究强调了早期诊断、准确评估严重程度、及时支持治疗、营养管理以及针对病因进行恰当治疗的重要性。
items.abstract_en: This article examines the clinical course, modern diagnostic approaches, and treatment principles of acute pancreatitis. The main clinical manifestations, etiological factors, laboratory parameters, imaging findings, disease severity, complications, and treatment outcomes were analyzed. The results demonstrated that biliary disease was the most common etiological factor, while severe epigastric pain, nausea, vomiting, and abdominal tenderness were the predominant clinical manifestations. Serum lipase and imaging methods played an important role in diagnosis and assessment of disease severity. Most patients had mild acute pancreatitis and showed favorable outcomes with conservative treatment. The study emphasizes the importance of early diagnosis, accurate severity assessment, timely supportive therapy, nutritional management, and appropriate treatment of the underlying cause.
items.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
items.summary_cn: 该研究分析急性胰腺炎的临床过程、诊断与治疗，发现胆道疾病是最常见病因，血清脂肪酶和影像学在诊断及严重度评估中起重要作用，多数患者为轻症且保守治疗预后良好，强调早期诊断、准确评估严重度、及时支持治疗、营养管理及针对病因治疗的重要性。

items.title_cn: 重症急性胰腺炎预测模型：从评分系统到人工智能的演变
items.title_en: Prediction models for severe acute pancreatitis: Evolution from scoring systems to artificial intelligence
items.summary_cn: 该论文标题表明其聚焦于重症急性胰腺炎预测模型的演变，从评分系统到人工智能，属于急性胰腺炎诊治中重症预测这一核心方向，与研究者关注的重症胰腺炎阶梯治疗高度相关。由于未提供摘要，无法总结具体核心发现。

items.title_cn: 甘油三酯-葡萄糖指数和C反应蛋白与白蛋白比值预测急性胰腺炎严重程度及28天死亡率的能力
items.title_en: Ability of the triglyceride–glucose index and C-reactive protein-to-albumin ratio to predict severity of acute pancreatitis and 28-day mortality
items.abstract_cn: 背景 重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）具有起病迅速、临床变化复杂和病死率高的特点。早期识别有重症化倾向的急性胰腺炎患者对于优化临床结局至关重要。然而，目前尚无有效的预测或评估工具。本研究旨在确定甘油三酯-葡萄糖（TyG）指数和C反应蛋白与白蛋白比值（CAR）预测SAP进展风险及28天病死率的能力。方法 本回顾性队列研究纳入316例诊断为急性胰腺炎的患者。收集背景特征信息，包括性别、年龄、合并症、病因因素、其他相关变量及实验室检查结果。主要终点为进展为SAP及SAP患者的28天病死率。通过logistic回归评估TyG指数和CAR与SAP风险的关联。通过受试者工作特征曲线分析评估预测性能，并通过1,000次bootstrap重抽样结合校准进行内部验证。采用Cox回归和Firth惩罚Cox回归评估28天病死率。采用Kaplan-Meier法比较组间生存情况。结果 SAP组的TyG指数和CAR值均显著高于非SAP组（均p < 0.001）。在充分调整潜在混杂因素后，多因素logistic回归显示，TyG指数（比值比2.42，95% CI 1.36–4.32，p = 0.003）和CAR（比值比1.40，95% CI 1.12–1.74，p = 0.003）与SAP独立相关。TyG指数和CAR预测SAP的表观曲线下面积分别为0.702和0.793；经bootstrap内部验证后，乐观校正曲线下面积分别为0.701和0.793，两者的乐观值均低于0.05，校准曲线显示预测概率与观察概率之间具有良好一致性。Firth惩罚似然Cox回归显示，TyG指数和CAR值升高与SAP患者28天病死率呈正相关，风险比分别为11.90（95% CI 3.47–50.53）和10.22（95% CI 2.31–96.19）。Kaplan-Meier生存分析证实，TyG指数≥12.12或CAR≥3.72的SAP患者临床结局显著更差（p < 0.001，log-rank检验）。结论 TyG指数和CAR被确定为急性胰腺炎进展为SAP的独立预测因子。高风险阈值（TyG指数≥12.12和CAR≥3.72）对SAP患者28天病死率显示出良好的预测性能，凸显了其在早期风险分层中的价值。然而，这些截断值仍需在前瞻性多中心队列中加以验证。
items.abstract_en: Background Severe acute pancreatitis (SAP) is characterized by rapid development, complex clinical changes, and a high mortality rate. Early identification of patients with acute pancreatitis that has the potential to become severe is important for optimizing clinical outcomes. However, at present, there is no effective prediction or evaluation tool. This study aimed to determine the ability of the triglyceride–glucose (TyG) index and C-reactive protein-to-albumin ratio (CAR) to predict the risk of progression to SAP and 28-day mortality. Methods This retrospective cohort study included 316 patients with a diagnosis of acute pancreatitis. Information on background characteristics, including sex, age, comorbidities, etiological factors, other relevant variables, and laboratory results was collected. The primary endpoints were progression to SAP and 28-day mortality in patients with SAP. Associations of the TyG index and CAR with the risk of SAP were assessed by logistic regression. Prediction performance was evaluated by receiver-operating characteristic curve analysis and internally validated via 1,000 bootstrap resamples with calibration. Cox regression and Firth’s penalized Cox regression were used to evaluate 28-day mortality. Survival was compared between groups using the Kaplan–Meier method. Results TyG index and CAR values were significantly higher in the SAP group than in the non-SAP group (both p < 0.001). After full adjustment for potential confounders, multivariate logistic regression, the TyG index (odds ratio 2.42, 95% CI 1.36–4.32, p = 0.003) and CAR (odds ratio 1.40, 95% CI 1.12–1.74, p = 0.003) were independently associated with SAP. The apparent areas under the curve for the TyG index and CAR for prediction of SAP were 0.702 and 0.793, respectively; following bootstrap internal validation, the optimism-corrected areas under the curve were 0.701 and 0.793, respectively, with optimism values below 0.05 in both cases and calibration curves demonstrating good agreement between predicted and observed probabilities. Firth’s penalized likelihood Cox regression revealed positive associations of elevated TyG index and CAR values with 28-day mortality in patients with SAP, with respective hazard ratios of 11.90 (95% CI 3.47–50.53) and 10.22 (95% CI 2.31–96.19). Kaplan–Meier survival analysis confirmed that clinical outcomes were significantly worse in patients with SAP and a TyG index ≥12.12 or CAR ≥ 3.72 ( p < 0.001, log-rank test). Conclusion The TyG index and CAR were identified as independent predictors of progression from acute pancreatitis to SAP. High-risk thresholds (TyG index ≥12.12 and CAR ≥ 3.72) showed good prediction performance for 28-day mortality in patients with SAP, highlighting their value for early risk stratification. Nevertheless, these cut-off values require validation in prospective multicenter cohorts.
items.summary_cn: 该研究发现甘油三酯-葡萄糖（TyG）指数和C反应蛋白与白蛋白比值（CAR）是急性胰腺炎进展为重症急性胰腺炎的独立预测因子，且高风险阈值（TyG指数≥12.12、CAR≥3.72）对重症急性胰腺炎患者28天死亡率具有良好预测效能，有助于早期风险分层。

items.title_cn: 抗蛋白酶药物在急性胰腺炎中的应用
items.title_en: THE USE OF ANTIPROTEASE DRUGS IN ACUTE PANCREATITIS
items.abstract_cn: 本论文探讨了抗蛋白酶制剂在急性胰腺炎治疗中的应用。研究聚焦于胰酶尤其是胰蛋白酶过早激活的致病作用，以及抑制蛋白水解活性的理论依据。文中讨论了加贝酯、萘莫司他和乌司他丁的临床特征及治疗潜力。当前证据表明，尽管抗蛋白酶药物可能影响某些炎症和生化指标，但其持续降低死亡率和严重并发症的能力尚未得到明确证实。因此，抗蛋白酶治疗应谨慎考虑，并主要在循证治疗策略框架内应用。
items.abstract_en: This thesis examines the use of antiprotease preparations in the management of acute pancreatitis. The study focuses on the pathogenetic role of premature activation of pancreatic enzymes, particularly trypsin, and the theoretical rationale for inhibiting proteolytic activity. The clinical characteristics and therapeutic potential of gabexate mesilate, nafamostat, and ulinastatin are discussed. Current evidence indicates that although antiprotease agents may influence certain inflammatory and biochemical parameters, their ability to consistently reduce mortality and severe complications has not been clearly established. Therefore, antiprotease therapy should be considered cautiously and primarily within evidence-based treatment strategies.
items.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
items.summary_cn: 该论文探讨抗蛋白酶制剂（加贝酯、萘莫司他、乌司他丁）在急性胰腺炎治疗中的应用，指出其虽可能影响部分炎症和生化指标，但尚未明确证实能持续降低死亡率和严重并发症，因此应谨慎使用并纳入循证治疗策略。

items.title_cn: 与壶腹相邻的误吞螺丝钉相关坏死性胰腺炎
items.title_en: Necrotizing Pancreatitis Associated With an Ingested Screw Adjacent to the Ampulla of Vater
items.abstract_cn: 摘要 一名78岁男性因严重上腹痛就诊，被诊断为急性胰腺炎，尽管给予支持治疗，病情仍进展为坏死性胰腺炎。未发现常见病因。在内镜下鼻空肠营养管置入过程中，偶然发现十二指肠降部邻近主乳头处有一枚金属螺钉，并成功取出。既往计算机断层扫描、超声或腹部X线检查均未检出该异物。患者完全康复，无复发。本病例突出了在 otherwise unexplained pancreatitis 中罕见的壶腹周围异物，并提出了机械性因素参与疾病发病机制的可能性。
items.abstract_en: ABSTRACT A 78-year-old man presented with severe epigastric pain and was diagnosed with acute pancreatitis that progressed to necrotizing pancreatitis despite supportive management. No common etiologies were identified. During endoscopic nasojejunal feeding tube placement, a metallic screw was incidentally discovered in the second portion of the duodenum adjacent to the major papilla and successfully removed. The foreign body had not been detected on previous computed tomography, ultrasound, or abdominal radiography. The patient recovered completely without recurrence. This case highlights a rare periampullary foreign body in otherwise unexplained pancreatitis and raises the possibility of a mechanical contribution to disease pathogenesis.
items.summary_cn: 该病例报告描述了一名78岁男性急性胰腺炎进展为坏死性胰腺炎，常规病因未明，在内镜下鼻空肠营养管置入时偶然发现并成功取出位于十二指肠降部邻近大乳头的金属螺钉，此前CT、超声和腹部X线均未检出。患者完全康复且无复发，提示不明原因胰腺炎中罕见的壶腹周围异物可能通过机械性机制参与疾病发病。

items.title_cn: 急性胰腺炎后血糖轨迹：一项前瞻性纵向研究
items.title_en: Trajectories of Glycemia Following Acute Pancreatitis: A Prospective Longitudinal Study
items.abstract_cn:
引言：急性胰腺炎（AP）可能导致葡萄糖代谢的持续性紊乱，其影响超出急性炎症发作的缓解期。然而，早期恢复期血糖异常的进展仍缺乏充分表征，凸显了进行前瞻性纵向评估的必要性。我们旨在通过确定新发糖尿病前期和糖尿病的累积发病率以及评估血糖参数的纵向变化，来评价AP发作后12个月随访期间的血糖轨迹。

方法：这项前瞻性纵向观察性研究纳入了77名诊断为AP且无既往糖尿病的成人患者，随访12个月。我们记录了临床特征、胰腺炎严重程度评分、实验室检查以及基线、6个月和12个月时的空腹血糖（FBG）、餐后血糖（PPBG）和糖化血红蛋白（HbA1c）水平。统计分析采用重复测量方差分析进行纵向比较，Bonferroni校正事后检验，以及McNemar检验用于分类结局。统计学显著性设定为p < 0.05。

结果：在77名参与者中，45名（58.4%）为男性，39名（50.6%）患有胆源性胰腺炎。随访期间，糖尿病前期的发病率从6个月时的12例（15.6%）显著增加至12个月时的19例（24.7%）（p = 0.023），而糖尿病的发病率从3例（3.9%）增加至5例（6.5%）；然而，差异无统计学意义（p = 0.480）。总体而言，血糖异常从15例（19.5%）显著增加至24例（31.2%）（p = 0.008）。重复测量分析显示，在12个月期间，FBG水平从96 ± 9.5 mg/dL显著升高至106 ± 17.0 mg/dL（p < 0.001），PPBG从127 ± 16.5 mg/dL升高至150 ± 35.0 mg/dL（p = 0.003），HbA1c从5.52% ± 0.11%升高至6.06 ± 0.40%（p < 0.001）。血糖轨迹分析显示，35名（45.5%）参与者保持在正常稳定组，35名（45.5%）呈现中度稳定模式，7名（9.1%）呈现高血糖轨迹。

结论：AP后第一年内血糖控制呈进行性恶化，近三分之一的患者发展为糖尿病前期或糖尿病。HbA1c表现出最大的纵向增幅，可作为识别胰腺炎后血糖异常风险患者的敏感标志物。这些发现支持AP后进行常规代谢监测，以促进早期诊断和及时干预。
items.abstract_en: Introduction: Acute pancreatitis (AP) may cause persistent disturbances in glucose metabolism that extend beyond the resolution of acute inflammatory episodes.However, the progression of glycemic abnormalities during the early recovery period remains insufficiently characterized, emphasizing the need for prospective longitudinal evaluation.We aimed to evaluate glycemia trajectories after an episode of AP over a 12-month follow-up by determining the cumulative incidence of new-onset prediabetes and diabetes and assessing longitudinal changes in glycemic parameters.Methods: This prospective longitudinal observational study included 77 adults diagnosed with AP without preexisting diabetes who were followed up for 12 months.We recorded clinical characteristics, pancreatitis severity scores, laboratory investigations, and fasting blood glucose (FBG), postprandial blood glucose (PPBG), and glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) levels at baseline, six months, and 12 months.Statistical analyses were performed using repeated-measures analysis of variance for longitudinal comparisons, Bonferroniadjusted post hoc tests, and McNemar's test for categorical outcomes.Statistical significance was set at p < 0.05.Results: Among the 77 participants, 45 (58.4%) were male participants, and 39 (50.6%) had biliary pancreatitis.During follow-up, the incidence of prediabetes increased significantly from 12 (15.6%)at six months to 19 (24.7%) at 12 months (p = 0.023), while that of diabetes increased from three (3.9%) to five (6.5%); however, the difference was not statistically significant (p = 0.480).Overall, glycemic abnormalities increased significantly from 15 (19.5%) to 24 (31.2%)(p = 0.008).Repeated-measures analysis demonstrated a significant increase in FBG levels from 96 ± 9.5 to 106 ± 17.0 mg/dL (p < 0.001), PPBG from 127 ± 16.5 to 150 ± 35.0 mg/dL (p = 0.003), and HbA1c from 5.52% ± 0.11% to 6.06 ± 0.40% (p < 0.001) over the 12-month period.Glycemic trajectory analysis showed that 35 (45.5%) participants remained in the normal-stable group, 35 (45.5%) exhibited a moderately stable pattern, and seven (9.1%) demonstrated a high glycemic trajectory.Conclusion: Progressive deterioration in glycemic control occurs during the first year following AP, with nearly one-third of the patients developing prediabetes or diabetes.HbA1c demonstrated the greatest longitudinal increase and may serve as a sensitive marker for identifying patients at risk for post-pancreatitis dysglycemia.These findings support routine metabolic surveillance after AP to facilitate early diagnosis and timely intervention.
items.summary_cn: 在急性胰腺炎发作后12个月内，糖代谢异常持续进展，糖尿病前期发生率从6个月的15.6%显著升至12个月的24.7%，总体糖代谢异常从19.5%升至31.2%；空腹血糖、餐后血糖和HbA1c均显著升高，HbA1c纵向增幅最大，可能作为识别胰腺炎后血糖异常风险患者的敏感标志物。

items.title_cn: 妊娠合并急性胰腺炎的母婴结局：病例系列及文献综述
items.title_en: Maternal and perinatal outcomes in acute pancreatitis complicating pregnancy: a case series and review of literature
items.abstract_cn: 妊娠期急性胰腺炎（APIP）并不常见，但可能是一种严重的母体和产科急症。其症状可能类似于常见的妊娠相关不适，使得早期诊断具有挑战性，尤其是在妊娠晚期。我们报告了三例在妊娠晚期发病的APIP病例。病例1为一名23岁G2P1L0孕妇，孕31周，表现为严重上腹痛、呕吐和早产。淀粉酶和脂肪酶显著升高，影像学检查发现急性坏死性胰腺炎伴局限性胰腺坏死、广泛胰周炎症、积液、轻度腹水、肠梗阻及左侧胸腔积液，确诊该病。随后出现胎儿窘迫，需紧急剖宫产分娩。术后她需要重症监护和通气支持。病例2为一名33+5周的多经产妇，有复发性胰腺炎、胎儿生长受限和贫血，表现为腹痛和胎动减少。经保守治疗好转，随后于35+5周接受引产，经阴道分娩一活产早产儿。病例3为一名31+5周的初产妇，患有妊娠期高血压和肝内胆汁淤积症，表现为上腹痛并向背部和肩部放射。胰腺酶升高证实了胰腺炎。她对保守治疗反应良好，随后经阴道分娩。所有患者均接受了禁食、静脉补液、电解质纠正、镇痛、抗生素及密切的母胎监测。母体存活率为100%，所有妊娠均以活产早产儿结束。早期识别和多学科管理对于APIP的良好结局至关重要。
items.abstract_en: Acute pancreatitis in pregnancy (APIP) is uncommon but can be a serious maternal and obstetric emergency. Its symptoms may resemble common pregnancy-related complaints, making early diagnosis challenging, particularly in the third trimester. We report three cases of APIP presenting in the third trimester. Case 1 was a 23-year-old G2P1L0 at 31 weeks who presented with severe epigastric pain, vomiting, and preterm labour. Markedly elevated amylase and lipase, along with imaging findings of acute necrotizing pancreatitis with limited pancreatic necrosis, extensive peripancreatic inflammation, collections, mild ascites, ileus, and left pleural effusion, confirmed the diagnosis. Fetal distress subsequently developed, necessitating emergency caesarean delivery. She required postoperative intensive care and ventilatory support. Case 2, a multigravida at 33+5 weeks with recurrent pancreatitis, fetal growth restriction, and anemia, presented with abdominal pain and reduced fetal movements. She improved with conservative management and later underwent induction at 35+5 weeks, resulting in a live preterm vaginal delivery. Case 3, a primigravida at 31+5 weeks with gestational hypertension and intrahepatic cholestasis, presented with epigastric pain radiating to the back and shoulder. Elevated pancreatic enzymes confirmed pancreatitis. She responded well to conservative treatment and subsequently delivered vaginally. All patients received bowel rest, intravenous fluids, electrolyte correction, analgesia, antibiotics, and close maternal-fetal monitoring. Maternal survival was 100%, and all pregnancies resulted in live preterm births. Early recognition and multidisciplinary management are crucial for favourable outcomes in APIP.
items.journal: International Journal of Reproduction Contraception Obstetrics and Gynecology
items.summary_cn: 该病例系列报告了三例妊娠晚期急性胰腺炎，其中一例为急性坏死性胰腺炎并需急诊剖宫产及术后重症监护，另两例经保守治疗成功并阴道分娩；所有患者均获母体存活及活产早产儿，强调早期识别和多学科管理对改善结局至关重要。

items.title_cn: 单细胞RNA测序揭示急性胰腺炎损伤与修复过程中腺泡细胞、巨噬细胞和中性粒细胞的PANoptosis特征
items.title_en: Single-cell RNA sequencing reveals PANoptosis signatures of acinar cells, macrophages, and neutrophils during injury and repair in acute pancreatitis
items.abstract_cn: 背景 急性胰腺炎（AP）涉及腺泡细胞损伤、炎症和组织重塑。尽管调节性细胞死亡通路参与AP进展，但PANoptosis的细胞类型特异性特征和动态变化仍不清楚。本研究旨在以单细胞分辨率表征胰腺细胞群体中PANoptosis相关特征。方法 建立雨蛙素联合脂多糖诱导的小鼠AP模型。通过单细胞RNA测序分析野生型、AP组和早期恢复组小鼠的胰腺组织。使用标记基因鉴定主要细胞类型和亚群。采用多种评分算法、拟时序分析和功能富集评估PANoptosis相关程序。进行组织学和免疫组织化学分析以验证结果。结果 单细胞图谱揭示AP及恢复过程中胰腺细胞微环境的广泛重塑，表现为腺泡细胞丢失以及巨噬细胞和中性粒细胞浸润增加。腺泡细胞亚群分析鉴定出12个转录上不同的亚群，包括以Krt19、Epcam、Lcn2和Krt7为标志的具有导管样特征的损伤相关亚群。轨迹分析提示从成熟消化酶分泌型腺泡状态向应激相关和炎症状态的动态转变。PANoptosis相关特征在炎症性腺泡亚群中最为显著，尤其是Cluster 10，其次是Cluster 7、4和5。巨噬细胞和中性粒细胞分析进一步鉴定出PANoptosis高表达的炎症亚群，尤其是巨噬细胞Cluster 4和中性粒细胞Cluster 4。结论 本研究建立了AP损伤与恢复的单细胞图谱，揭示了腺泡细胞和炎症细胞群体中细胞特异性PANoptosis程序，突出表明PANoptosis是腺泡损伤、免疫激活和胰腺重塑之间的潜在联系。
items.abstract_en: Background Acute pancreatitis (AP) involves acinar cell injury, inflammation, and tissue remodeling. Although regulated cell death pathways contribute to AP progression, the cell type-specific features and dynamics of PANoptosis remain unclear. This study aimed to characterize PANoptosis-associated signatures in pancreatic cell populations at single-cell resolution. Methods A caerulein plus lipopolysaccharide-induced mouse AP model was established. Pancreatic tissues from wild-type, AP, and early recovery groups were analyzed by single-cell RNA sequencing. Major cell types and subclusters were identified using marker genes. PANoptosis-related programs were evaluated using multiple scoring algorithms, pseudotime analysis, and functional enrichment. Histological and immunohistochemical analyses were performed for validation. Results Single-cell profiling revealed extensive remodeling of the pancreatic cellular microenvironment during AP and recovery, characterized by acinar cell loss and increased macrophage and neutrophil infiltration. Acinar cell subclustering identified 12 transcriptionally distinct subpopulations, including injury-associated subsets with ductal-like features marked by Krt19, Epcam, Lcn2, and Krt7. Trajectory analysis suggested dynamic transitions from mature digestive enzyme-producing acinar states toward stress-associated and inflammatory states. PANoptosis-related signatures were most prominent in inflammatory acinar subsets, particularly Cluster 10, followed by Clusters 7, 4, and 5. Macrophage and neutrophil analyses further identified PANoptosis-high inflammatory subsets, especially macrophage Cluster 4 and neutrophil Cluster 4. Conclusion This study establishes a single-cell atlas of AP injury and recovery, revealing cell-specific PANoptosis programs in acinar cells and inflammatory populations, highlighting PANoptosis as a potential link between acinar injury, immune activation, and pancreatic remodeling.
items.journal: Frontiers in Cell and Developmental Biology
items.summary_cn: 该研究通过单细胞RNA测序构建了小鼠急性胰腺炎损伤与恢复期的胰腺细胞图谱，发现腺泡细胞、巨噬细胞和中性粒细胞中存在细胞类型特异性的PANoptosis相关特征，其中炎症性腺泡细胞亚群（尤其是Cluster 10）及巨噬细胞Cluster 4和中性粒细胞Cluster 4的PANoptosis信号最为显著。研究提示PANoptosis可能是连接腺泡损伤、免疫激活与胰腺重塑的潜在机制。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
